body:
repo:objectstack#9 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVcCALJF1zeGDJFHBV

⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** This post is the seat, **`repo:objectstack` seat 9** (the whole-repo lane). Only what another account must read lives here.
- Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` and `references/area-lease.md` (⛔ not copied here).
- New seat: seats 1–8 are #34366, #34478, #34584, #34830, #35217, #35381, #35557, #35560; none is vacant, so this is seat 9.

## Current PM — 🟢 os-sales

- **Holder:** `os-sales` · `session_01L6bhgVcCALJF1zeGDJFHBV`, seated at this post's creation time on the maintainer's summons in this project, verbatim (2026-11-19 15:30Z): 「再开一个 area:fleet」.
- **Intake:** open cards labelled `area:fleet` in objectstack-ai/objectstack whose fix lands in this repository, `priority:p1` first, then p2. p3 only rides along on a PR that touches the same files (≤5 cards per PR); no standalone p3. The maintainer, verbatim (2026-11-19 15:30Z): 「你都是只做 p1 p2 ，p3 只能顺带做」.
  - Excluded: cloud cards (`repo:cloud` seats), security cards and advisories (`security` seats; #35108 is left to them), other repositories, `needs-user-decision` / `pm:retriage` cards, and cards another seat holds (another seat's `Claim:`, `Area:` line or assignee).
  - Seat 5 (#35217, os-bill) is running `area:fleet` cards in its area `fleet-1` (#35215 #35230 #35234 #35237 #35350 #35470, the skills clean-up chain #35231 #35232 #35235 #35238 behind #35230). This seat does not touch them; the split for the rest is proposed on seat 5's mailbox #35216.
- **Mailbox:** written in the first audit comment below once opened. **Patrol:** written there too.
- **Posture ledger:** the labels, the assignee, the `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: repo:objectstack#9`, and the `head:claude/` PRs.

## Leases

Areas carry the `f9-` prefix; an area is named only in this table and in the claims' `Area:` line. Thread session for every area = this session (os-dev subagents) unless a card thread is named; L1 = an L1 thread named here once the first PR is up.

| Area | Path roots | Cards (p1/p2; p3 ride-along) |
|---|---|---|
| `f9-A` | `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`, `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`, `scripts/qa/**`, `scripts/ci/**`, the fleet patrol workflows | #35297, #35322 (resume PR #35343); p3 #34975 #34804 #34805 #34783 #31518 ride only on the same files |
| `f9-B` | `scripts/pm/check-governed-*.mjs`, `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `.github/CODEOWNERS`, the path-fork region of pm-dispatch `SKILL.md`, `references/contract-review.md` | #35321 (serial with seat 5 on `SKILL.md`); p3 #34680 rides |
| `f9-C` | the flaky test files the cards name (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/**` tests, `scripts/root-index.test.ts`) | #35111 (after triage first touch); p3 #34233 #34234 ride |

Not leased here until seat 5 answers on #35216: p1 #35229 #35270 #35283 (pm-dispatch text and the skill ratchet, the same files as seat 5's chain) and epic #35205's children #35208–#35213. Cards without a triage audit record (#35111 #35229 #35270 #35283) wait for triage's first touch before claim. Every claim re-runs `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`.

## Hot-file serial queue

- pm-dispatch `SKILL.md`: seat 5's chain #35230 → #35231 → #35232 → #35235 → #35238; #35321 (`f9-B`, path-fork region only) is placed by agreement with seat 5.

## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- Tier H approvers: os-zhuang, hotlong. Governed-surface PRs (`.claude/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`) are not landed by an area.
- Publication: objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
